findings.message: Element "DataObject_invoice" (dataObject) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "DataObject_invoice" (dataObject) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.

findings.message: Element "DataObjectRef_invoice" (dataObjectReference) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "DataObjectRef_invoice" (dataObjectReference) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.

findings.message: Element "DataStore_ledger" (dataStoreReference) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "DataStore_ledger" (dataStoreReference) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.
Name start events using "Object + past participle", e.g. "Order Received", "Payment Initiated".
Name end events using "Object + state", e.g. "Order Fulfilled", "Payment Failed", "Request Rejected".

findings.message: Start event "Start_data" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.

findings.message: "Post to ledger" (serviceTask) has no zeebe:taskDefinition type.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.
